verdict.rationale: Alma's founder O-1A page says the O-1 'can serve as a foundation for a later EB-1A or EB-2 NIW green card petition, since much of the same evidence carries forward.' The firm also publishes EB-1 and EB-2 NIW guides and shows EB-1A self-petition alongside the O-1A recommendation. The continuation itself is covered only in a single sentence, with no documented step-by-step strategy for the move from O-1 to green card. missing for 10: a detailed O-1-to-green-card transition plan (timing, dual-intent handling, choosing EB-1A vs NIW), confirmation that the service packages or executes the continuation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end
